about.title: About TuringVote
about.intro: TuringVote is a 2-choice poll where every voter is a World ID Verified Human — no bots, no duplicate accounts, no sybil attacks. You see how real people actually decided.
about.utilityHeading: What you get out of it
about.utility1Title: A bot-free mirror of public opinion
about.utility1Desc: Twitter polls, Reddit, comments — frequently gamed by bots and sock puppets. TuringVote uses World ID to enforce one vote per Verified Human, so the percentages you see reflect votes from verified humans only — without bot inflation or duplicate accounts.
about.utility2Desc: After 5 questions, you get a one-screen profile: are you majority-leaning, minority-leaning, or balanced? It's a 90-second self-mirror you can't get from any survey.
about.utility3Desc: Right after each tap, see if you went with the crowd or against it. Coffee or tea, logic or intuition, stability or challenge — find out where you stand.
about.how1: Sign in with your World Wallet (one tap, no password).
about.how2: Answer 5 short 2-choice questions — about 90 seconds total.
about.how3: After each answer, the live tally appears: % chose A vs % chose B (Verified Humans only).
about.how4: At the end, get your personal pattern summary and share it.
about.use1Desc: Settle the everyday debates: morning person or night owl? Cats or dogs? See what the world actually thinks.
about.use2Desc: Twitter polls, Reddit, comment-section votes — easy to game with throwaway accounts. TuringVote uses World ID so the percentages reflect votes from Verified Humans only.
about.use3Desc: Each session ends with a snapshot of how you compare to thousands of Verified Humans. A 90-second mirror you can share or keep private.
about.privacy1: We don't collect names, emails, phones, or device fingerprints. IP addresses are used only for short-lived rate-limit buckets to prevent spam, never stored long-term and never linked to your votes.
about.privacy2: Each vote is keyed only by an action-scoped identifier (World ID nullifier hash for Orb verification, or a server-side HMAC of your wallet address for wallet sign-in). Both are scoped to TuringVote and cannot be reversed back to your wallet or identity.
about.privacy3: Aggregate counts are public; individual votes are never exposed.
about.privacy4: No rewards, no tokens, no points, no leaderboards. TuringVote is not a game and not gambling.
about.eligibility: Anyone with a verified World ID or a World App wallet, age 18+. One vote per question per Verified Human, enforced at the database level.
